envelope.description: Show the readiness notice to the author on the terminal path

body.title: Show the readiness notice to the author on the terminal path
body.summary: Add issueReadiness and notice to the streaming client and its result type (src/mcp/daemon-stream.ts, RunWorkflowStreamResult), the CLI service (src/cli/services/workflow.ts runWorkflowStreaming) and print the failure notice in the run handler of src/cli/command.ts.
acceptanceChecks: runWorkflowStreaming preserves issueReadiness and notice from the done frame.
The run command prints the notice when the draft is not ready and prints nothing extra otherwise, proven by a test of the printed output.

tests.name: src/cli/__tests__/run-readiness-notice.test.ts: runWorkflowStreaming preserves the fields and the run command prints the notice only when not ready
